arms.source: 704626 procs and applies 556233 once on the untriggered 34580 strike in the treatment phase (0 in control), proving the 0 aura read at expiry is genuine expiration rather than a missed strike

behaviours.observe_source: Companion to duration_held for Thick Pelt 704626 ($556233d = 10000 ms). Same precondition fixtures (33143 on caster, 803393 on dummy for +100% hit) and untriggered dummy_casts_at_caster 34580 strike at +100 ms (gap_ms 1000) then wait_ms 9400: control (before learning 704626) reads aura 556233 == 0 and aura_apply_count(556233) == 0; after a real learn of 704626, ally_arm proves aura_apply_count(556233) == 1 (applied once on the strike) while aura 556233 reads expired (0) at game_time.after [10450, 10850] ms after trigger 60235 (10350..10750 ms after the 34580 strike, strictly < 11000 ms = +10%). Together duration_held [9250, 9650] (9150..9550 ms from hit) and duration_gone [10450, 10850] (10350..10750 ms from hit) bracket 10000 ms inside +-10% on both sides. Reference search 2026-11-26: see duration_held.

Control arm has no 704626; prime arm learns 704626 for real and takes untriggered 34580 strikes (600 fixed Physical DmgClass 2, IMPOSSIBLE_DODGE_PARRY_BLOCK, striker_untriggered: true) to arm 556233 via real proc; thick_pelt arm checks aura 556233 == 1 then takes 10 untriggered strikes of 34580, each reduced by 59 (600 - 59 scaled by the control armor factor, excluding 0 reduction and doubled 118 reduction) while re-arming 556233 via 704626 (556233 < 704626 in m_ownedAuras). Reference search 2026-11-26: see duration_held.

behaviours.quote: Increases your chance to resist curse effects by $s1%.

Server SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3212-3214) instead multiplies ManaCostPercentage by GetCreateHealth() (level-60 Bloodmage BaseHP = 65 + 1483 - 44 = 1504 via rev_20260903_01_live_class_baseline.sql:928 + rev_20260912_00_custom_class_stat_progression.sql, Druid fallback 11), deducting 1353 HP (13.53% of 10000, or 64.3% of natural level-60 max health 2104) and leaving 8647 HP. Kept unweakened per G-31 / Bucket 4 cross-ref A so the alert stands honestly for owner ruling (see ADR 1318 for Cultist base_health comparison; Bloodmage has no base_mana). Reference search 2026-11-26: see summon_ritual.

behaviours.expected_source: Second Rage-level arm for Night Feast 563736 (AscensionBloodmageVitality.cpp:184-191,221-228): at cast_power 1000 (100 displayed Rage) with +20000 SP fixture and 823764 spellpen over 20 non-critical Bloodbolt 578305 hits per arm, expected ratio is 2.00 (+100%, G-19 band +95%..+105%, excluding +40% and 0%). Together with damage_40_rage (+40% at 40 Rage) proves the exact +1% per point of Rage slope. Reference search 2026-11-26: see damage_40_rage.

behaviours.name: Night Feast (increases Bloodbolt Rage cost by 10: 300 -> 400 internal)
behaviours.quote: but its Rage cost is increased by $/10;s2.
behaviours.observe_source: Night Feast 563736 Effect[1] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 14 SPELLMOD_COST, BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100 internal Rage (+10 displayed, $/10;s2 = 10) on EffectSpellClassMask[1] 131072 = Bloodbolt 578305 (base ManaCost 300 internal Rage; /srv/coa/server-data/dbc Spell.dbc). With cast_power 500 and disable_regeneration true: Rage drops 500 -> 200 (300 spent) before 563736 and 500 -> 100 (400 spent) after a real learn of 563736 (exact integer match, excluding 0 and doubled +200). Reference search 2026-11-26: coabuildhub/bindmysoul 563736 state 'its Rage cost is increased by 10.'.

behaviours.name: Leeching Tome (Bloodbolt leeches 50% more health: 1.0 -> 1.5)
behaviours.quote: Your Bloodbolt now leeches $s1% more health,
behaviours.observe_source: Leeching Tome 807489 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 27 SPELLMOD_VALUE_MULTIPLIER, BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50% ($s1) on EffectSpellClassMask[1] 131072 = Bloodbolt 578305 (Effect[0] 9 SPELL_EFFECT_HEALTH_LEECH, EffectValueMultiplier 1.0, Speed 30 yd/s; /srv/coa/server-data/dbc Spell.dbc). Spell::EffectHealthLeech (Spell.cpp:2934-2954) multiplies damage by CalcValueMultiplier (1.0 -> 1.50). Cast at dummy 10 yd away (~333 ms flight, wait_ms 1500 gives >1100 ms buffer) with 823764 spellpen and phase_since isolating each phase: spell_heal_total / spell_damage_total reads 1.00 +- 0.005 before 807489 and 1.50 +- 0.005 after (excluding 1.00 no-effect and 2.00 doubled). Precedent: Hematoma 504896 in bloodmage.json. Reference search 2026-11-26: coa-history 807489: 0 events (passive), 578305: 3764 hits / 3764 heals across 17 logs; coabuildhub and bindmysoul 807489 match verbatim.
